title: Correct persisted immutable and candidate metadata
notes: QAController._started_at is initialized once at startup and preserved immutably across all state persistence calls and DB updates.
ControllerDB schema and queries store candidate_base_sha, candidate_branch, candidate_head, and candidate_worktree in distinct, dedicated columns.
ON CONFLICT(run_id) DO UPDATE SET preserves started_at immutability in the database.
